description: This file defines classes related to representing differences in various IR (Intermediate Representation) components, such as types, functions, enums, and record types, for a header checking tool in the Android Open Source Project.

classes.name: DiffMessageIR
classes.description: Base class for IR diff messages, representing a generic diff with a kind and name.

classes.name: AccessSpecifierDiffIR
classes.description: Represents the difference in access specifiers between two IR elements.

classes.name: TypeDiffIR
classes.description: Represents differences in type sizes and alignments.

classes.name: CXXBaseSpecifierDiffIR
classes.description: Represents differences in C++ base specifiers.

classes.name: RecordTypeDiffIR
classes.description: Represents differences in record types, including fields, vtable, and base specifiers.

classes.name: EnumTypeDiffIR
classes.description: Represents differences in enum types, including fields and underlying type.

classes.name: FunctionDiffIR
classes.description: Represents differences between functions, including whether they are extended.
